Class Commerce

java.lang.Object
commerces.Commerce
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
CarDealership, Restaurant
public abstract class Commerce extends Object implements Cloneable
Abstract base class representing a generic commerce (business).

Holds common data shared by all commerce subtypes (CarDealership and Restaurant): commercial name, address, tax identifier, a daily-sales matrix, a stock array, and an array of Employee objects.

The dailySales matrix has dimensions 12×31, where the first index represents the month (0-based) and the second the day (0-based).

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez
